pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * NULLIF(SUM(dc.total_amount) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(d."Amount"), 0), 0), 0), 2) AS percent_from_multiple_donors, COUNT(DISTINCT dc."Donor") AS number_of_multiple_donors FROM donor_counts AS dc JOIN donations AS d ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"
